source.name: South African Football Association: SAFA, adidas unveil the 2026/2027 South Africa home jersey
source.note: Kit maker. SAFA's own launch announcement names adidas on the 2026/2027 home jersey for Bafana Bafana and Banyana Banyana; adidas became SAFA's official technical sponsor in a three-year partnership announced 2025-10-17 (https://www.safa.net/general-news/safa-announces-adidas-as-new-official-technical-sponsor/). Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up (2026-03-03, https://www.footballshirtculture.com/new-kits/south-africa-2026-2027-home-jersey.html) describes the chest carrying only the SAFA crest, the South African Football Association emblem and the adidas logo, with green shorts and yellow socks in the matching kit; its six launch-gallery photos show no commercial marks on the front, sleeves or shorts. No back photo was published, so the back layout is undocumented.
source.quote: Today, the South African Football Association (SAFA) in collaboration with adidas proudly reveals the new 2026/2027 home jersey for both Bafana Bafana and Banyana Banyana

summary: adidas home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle (adidas became SAFA's official technical sponsor in a three-year partnership announced in October 2025). No commercial shirt sponsors: SAFA's launch announcement and Football Shirt Culture's write-up describe only the SAFA crest, the SAFA emblem and adidas branding on the shirt, with matching sponsor-free green shorts and yellow socks.
